source.title: Optional API supplier / Provider proposal with settled model costs
source.body:
Hi StudioMCPHub team — I’m Yami from ToAPIs.

We reviewed StudioMCPHub’s paid MCP image tools and hosted GPU-backed generation and prepared original API examples, model-specific parameters and dated Key rates:
https://github.com/ToAPIs-2025/lower-cost-studiomcphub-toapis

On October 29, our test Key settled gpt-image-2 / 1K at $0.015/image and gpt-image-2.5-flare / 1K at $0.0225/image. These are optional GPT Image routes, not the same SD3.5 model priced differently. MCP payment and safety semantics remain yours. The examples are independent API results, not native product acceptance or universal tariffs.

We can support three practical routes: an optional Provider with evaluation credits and hands-on integration/debugging help; product/documentation sponsorship; or supplementary upstream API supply for your own hosted service. Larger-volume pricing can be discussed against your required models, specifications and expected usage. Your existing branding, accounts, wallet and supplier routes can be retained.

Could the maintainer responsible for image/video models or upstream sourcing review these options? We would be happy to support a model your team actually needs and agree an evaluation scope together.

Thank you,
YamiAnn — ToAPIs Team
yami@toapis.com
